scripts.text: There is no way to find out what the state of the repeater is. The communication chip seems to be properly installed.
scripts.translation: 無法查明中繼器的狀態。通訊晶片似乎已正確安裝。

scripts.text:
^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800等一下！！
由於您攜帶的物品過多，無法再接收任何物品。請在減輕負重後重試。^000000

scripts.text: The body of Manager Beta is hidden under the landscapes.
scripts.translation: 管理員貝塔的遺體隱藏在風景之下。

scripts.text:
The core slot is empty.
I'll let Alpha know later so she can retrieve the doll's body.
The core part is empty.
scripts.translation:
核心插槽是空的。
我稍後會通知阿爾法，讓她取回玩偶的軀體。
核心部件是空的。

scripts.text:
I've recovered the core.
I'll let Alpha know later so she can retrieve the doll's body.
The core part is empty.
scripts.translation:
我已恢復核心。
我稍後會通知阿爾法，讓她取回玩偶的軀體。
核心部件是空的。
